risk_if_not_implemented: Without Account Separation Between Infrastructure Environments, unauthorized users may gain access to systems or data, increasing risk of data breaches and privilege escalation.

compensating_control_1.name: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement network segmentation within network architectures to isolate Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) from other network resources.
compensating_control_1.justification: Network Segmentation (macrosegmentation) (NET-06) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Account Separation Between Infrastructure Environments (IAC-15.10) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Privileged Account Management (PAM)
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to restrict and control privileged access rights for users and Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS).
compensating_control_2.justification: Privileged Account Management (PAM) (IAC-16) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Account Separation Between Infrastructure Environments (IAC-15.10) by restricting system and data access through alternative identity and access management mechanisms. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
